sql: SELECT SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.date >= '2026-05-31 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
SELECT SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.product_id IN ('a', 'b', 'c')

SELECT SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.product_id IN ('a', 'c') AND o.date >= '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-05-01 00:00:00'
SELECT SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.date >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
